prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion sheet as the only visual reference. Generate one polished 3 rows by 4 columns source contact sheet with exactly twelve equally spaced V9-matched anchors in this order: daily attention left, right, up, down; curious question; brief alert surprise; joyful spark; affectionate warm; recording focus; listening focus; menu thinking; peaceful sleep. This is one persistent character identity with twelve different emotional expressions, not twelve neutral-face variations. It is a component-source candidate for later entry-hold-settle choreography, never a replacement V9 sheet or animation flipbook. Pure white background; black and white only; no text, panel, border or device frame. HARD EYE IDENTITY INVARIANT FOR EVERY OPEN-EYE CELL: exactly two matched upright solid filled black vertical oval eye bodies on one horizontal baseline, with compact locked-V9 scale and whitespace. Each eye has only one compact upper primary white reflection and one much smaller static white diamond sparkle. No white cap, lower-half cutout, sclera, ring, outline, pupil, lash, altered eye shape or enlarged eye. DAILY DIRECTION REPAIR: in both eyes of cell 1 the compact primary reflection center is clearly left-biased at about 30 percent of eye width; cell 2 is clearly right-biased at about 70 percent; cell 3 is clearly upper-biased near 25 percent of eye height; cell 4 is clearly lower-biased near 70 percent. These are small internal reflection shifts, not giant white holes. The diamond sparkle remains static. Communicate all emotion via paired brows, petite nose/mouth, cheeks and at most one detached charm: curious question, alert exclamation/O mouth, joy spark/joyful mouth, affection heart/warm cheeks, recording dot/focused brow, listening sound arcs, menu ellipsis, sleep closed curved eyes and tiny rest mouth with no moon/crescent/Z. Each state must read as a distinct, adorable V9 expression at 100px thumbnail while eye bodies remain the same. No cat outline, ears, whiskers, human styling, smirk, flirtation, romance, sadness, aggression, grey, gradient, shading, texture, labels, charging face or error face.

no moon, crescent, Z, charging or error face
